host.description: The hostname for this HTTPRoute. If not set, the HTTPRoute will not be created.

parentRefs.description: Kubernetes Gateway API ParentReference specification (https://gateway-api.sigs.k8s.io/reference/spec/#parentreference). Defines the Gateway resource(s) that this HTTPRoute should attach to. If not set, the global gateway.parentRefs will be used.

group.description: Group of the Gateway API resource (default: gateway.networking.k8s.io)

kind.description: Kind of the Gateway API resource (default: Gateway)

sectionName.description: Name of the Listener on the Gateway that this route would attach to (optional)

port.description: Port number of the Listener on the Gateway that this route would attach to (optional)
